## RADIOLOGY / LABORATORY REPORT

Patient Name: Robert Miller Patient ID: MRN-118354 Report Date: 2025-11-23 Ordering Physician: Dr. Thornton Study / Modality: MRI Brain Body Site: Brain

## FINDINGS

No acute infarct, haemorrhage, or mass effect. Ventricles and sulci are age-appropriate. No abnormal enhancement after contrast. A few scattered T2/FLAIR hyperintense foci in the subcortical white matter.

## IMPRESSION

Nonspecific white matter changes, likely microvascular.
